title: Peradeniya RoboHack
description: Teams build and program a small autonomous rover to complete an obstacle course revealed on the day. A limited number of starter kits were available to loan for teams without their own hardware.
location: Faculty of Engineering, University of Peradeniya
whoCanParticipate: Open to undergraduates from any faculty. Teams of 2-4, at least one member with basic electronics experience recommended.
